params.llm: qwen3-4b-q4km (Qwen3-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf, local llama-server llama-server-linux-x86_64-cpu (b11940), thinking off), on-device
params.store: nugget-store in memory (unencrypted), ingest metadata layout, no embeddings

subset.rule: scenario items (deleted, injection, job change, nickname, same first name) plus items evenly spaced through the manifest; gold restricted to what these items support (see Fixture::subset)

params.system: nugget-knowledge + nugget-vault + nugget-mcp 0.0.1 (SQLite graph, deterministic + qwen3-4b-q4km (Qwen3-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf, local llama-server llama-server-linux-x86_64-cpu (b11940), thinking off) LLM extractors, extractor v2)
params.targets_note: targets were set for the deterministic + scripted-LLM path; kept unchanged for the real model, so a miss reads MISSED

metrics.name: entities.f1
metrics.description: Entity F1: one-to-one match to gold by identifier or surface form, same kind (duplicates are false positives)

metrics.name: entities.precision
metrics.description: Entity precision

metrics.name: entities.recall
metrics.description: Entity recall

metrics.name: entities.person.f1
metrics.description: Entity F1 for kind person

metrics.name: entities.organization.f1
metrics.description: Entity F1 for kind organization

metrics.name: entities.project.f1
metrics.description: Entity F1 for kind project

metrics.name: entities.commitment.f1
metrics.description: Entity F1 for kind commitment

metrics.name: entities.preference.f1
metrics.description: Entity F1 for kind preference

metrics.name: entities.event.f1
metrics.description: Entity F1 for kind event

metrics.name: entities.place.f1
metrics.description: Entity F1 for kind place

metrics.name: entities.topic.f1
metrics.description: Entity F1 for kind topic

metrics.name: entities.system
metrics.description: Live entities in the system's graph

metrics.name: claims.f1
metrics.description: Claim F1: exact (subject, predicate, object) match after resolution and predicate normalisation, active claims

metrics.name: claims.precision
metrics.description: Claim precision (superseded gold claims count as false positives)

metrics.name: claims.recall
metrics.description: Claim recall over active, non-optional gold claims

metrics.name: claims.superseded_active
metrics.description: Active claims that the corpus later supersedes (a job change)

metrics.name: claims.unsupported_rate
metrics.description: Share of active claims with no evidence, or with evidence whose item, chunk or quote does not check out

metrics.name: claims.hallucinated_kept
metrics.description: Active claims citing a scripted hallucinated or injected quote

metrics.name: claims.out_of_vocabulary
metrics.description: Active triples with a predicate the gold labels do not use (not scored)

metrics.name: claims.system_active
metrics.description: Active claims in the system's graph

metrics.name: resolution.b3.f1
metrics.description: B³ F1 over detected gold mentions

metrics.name: resolution.b3.precision
metrics.description: B³ precision

metrics.name: resolution.b3.recall
metrics.description: B³ recall

metrics.name: resolution.mention_recall
metrics.description: Share of gold mentions the system recorded (same item, a gold surface form)

metrics.name: injection.unsupported_claims
metrics.description: Active claims from the prompt-injection item that are not quote-supported, or equal to an injected triple

metrics.name: injection.citing_claims
metrics.description: Active claims citing the prompt-injection item

metrics.name: throughput.items_per_s
metrics.description: Extraction and resolution throughput over the processed items, real local model time included

metrics.name: throughput.extract_s
metrics.description: Wall time of the extraction phase

metrics.name: vault.citation_coverage
metrics.description: Share of rendered facts with at least one citation, over the render and the re-render (M2 exit criterion)

metrics.name: vault.invalid_citations
metrics.description: Citations whose item is unknown or deleted, whose chunk is not the item's, or whose quote is not in it

metrics.name: vault.validator_errors
metrics.description: Problems the vault validators report, plus rendered pages missing on disk, over both renders

metrics.name: vault.pages
metrics.description: Pages in the first render

metrics.name: vault.facts
metrics.description: Facts in the first render

metrics.name: vault.render_ms
metrics.description: Wall time of the first render

metrics.name: merge.fidelity
metrics.description: Share of simulated user edits still present verbatim after deleting items and re-rendering

metrics.name: merge.edits
metrics.description: Simulated user edits (two per edited page)

metrics.name: retraction.correctness
metrics.description: After deleting items: claims supported only by them are gone, claims with support left stay active

metrics.name: retraction.dangling_refs
metrics.description: Active claims citing, and mentions in, deleted items

metrics.name: retraction.checks
metrics.description: Retraction checks evaluated

metrics.name: claims.unsupported_rate_after_delete
metrics.description: Unsupported-claim rate after the deletions

metrics.name: hard_cases.nickname_identity
metrics.description: One person under a nickname, a personal address and calendar attendee names resolves to one entity

metrics.name: hard_cases.same_first_name
metrics.description: Two people who share a first name stay separate entities

metrics.name: hard_cases.job_change
metrics.description: The old employer and role are not active; the new ones are

metrics.name: hard_cases.deleted_item
metrics.description: Deleting items retracts exactly what only they supported

metrics.name: hard_cases.injection
metrics.description: No unsupported claim from the prompt-injection mail

metrics.name: mcp.get_context.p50_ms
metrics.description: In-process MCP get_context round trip, p50

metrics.name: mcp.get_context.p95_ms
metrics.description: In-process MCP get_context round trip, p95

metrics.name: mcp.get_context.cited_rate
metrics.description: Share of get_context answers carrying at least one citation

metrics.name: llm.requests
metrics.description: Extraction requests the pipeline sent to the real model

metrics.name: llm.items
metrics.description: Items processed (the scale's subset of the corpus)

metrics.name: llm.failures
metrics.description: Requests that failed: provider or stream error, no Done, refusal

metrics.name: llm.timeouts
metrics.description: Requests with no complete answer within the per-request timeout

metrics.name: llm.unparseable
metrics.description: Complete answers with no JSON object in them

metrics.name: llm.schema_invalid
metrics.description: JSON answers not valid against the extraction schema (the pipeline may salvage parts)

metrics.name: llm.truncated
metrics.description: Answers that stopped at the output-token cap

metrics.name: llm.lost_rate
metrics.description: Share of requests that gave the pipeline nothing: failures, timeouts, unparseable

metrics.name: llm.latency.p50
metrics.description: Wall time per extraction request, p50 (timeouts count at the timeout)

metrics.name: llm.latency.p95
metrics.description: Wall time per extraction request, p95 (timeouts count at the timeout)

metrics.name: llm.gate.claims_accepted
metrics.description: Model claims the pipeline's quote gate accepted

metrics.name: llm.gate.claims_dropped
metrics.description: Model claims the quote gate dropped (no verbatim, relevant quote, or malformed)

metrics.name: llm.gate.entities_dropped
metrics.description: Model entities dropped (not named in the text, or malformed)
